staff.title: GCSE Digital Technology · Unit 5 · Staff
home.cwSub: This guide helps you create your Unit 5 program, one part at a time.
home.header: Tick the parts you have done. Then open the first part that is not ticked.
home.hadAsk: Tick every step of chapter {n} as already done? You can undo this on the card.
home.reveal: A bonus chapter has appeared. It is completely optional.
foot.ticked: Ticked. On to the next screen.
fixed.names: These are the names in MY example. Yours may be different. To find yours: Design tab, click the control once, read the top of the Properties window.
fixed.isense1: Type the first few letters and the list appears. Press Tab to take the one you want.
fixed.isense2: If you gave your control a different name, YOUR name is in YOUR list. Pick yours.
fixed.typing: Type it. You cannot copy from this guide. Typing is how it sticks.
fixed.flow: A switched-off panel is grey. Nothing in it can be clicked. Enabled = false switches it off. Enabled = true switches it on.
fixed.howName: How do I find my name?
code.toast: Type it in Visual Studio 2019: that is how it sticks.
code.given: Visual Studio wrote this line for you
code.continues: The rest of this code is on the next screen.
isense.title: IntelliSense
check.have.title: Have you got this?
check.have.intro: Open your project in the Programming Environment and look. Tick each row you have. A row you have not got tells you where to go.
check.try.title: Try it
check.try.intro: Click the green Start arrow and try each row in your running program.
check.design.intro: Look at your form in the Design tab. Tick each row that is right. A row that is wrong tells you where to go.
pop.title: Before you go in, Google will ask you one question
pop.line1: This is normal. It lets the guide remember your ticks so you can carry on next lesson.
pop.line2: If you see 'Google hasn't verified this app', choose Advanced. Then choose 'Go to OLS GCSE DT Coursework Guide'.
